data.one_liner: Functional programming types and patterns for Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides core functional programming types and patterns like Option, Either, IO, Task, Reader, State, and immutable collections. Fully documented and tested.
use_when: You want to enforce strict error handling using Either instead of throwing exceptions.
You want to handle missing values safely using the Option type.
You prefer functional programming patterns in your Dart and Flutter applications.
avoid_when: Your team is not familiar with functional programming concepts and prefers standard imperative Dart style.
You only need simple async utilities already available in standard Dart libraries.
strengths: Comprehensive suite of functional types (Option, Either, Task, Reader, State, etc.).
First-class support for Dart 3 features like sealed classes, pattern matching, and records.
Extensive documentation and blog posts/tutorials by the author.
weaknesses: Steep learning curve for developers new to functional programming paradigms.
Version 2 rewrite is currently in development and pre-release stage.
